name: No Overhead
reference: 60s repurposed podcast interview: tight on her, then a wide two-shot, back to tight. A white boxed hook sits low for the whole video with a small dark caption strip under it.
edit_notes:
A flex that turns into a confession: 15 seconds of an impossible-sounding result ('[result] with no [thing everyone assumes it needs]:'), then the honest, human reason and a disarming kicker. One box hook, lowercase, ending in a colon, pinned the whole Reel.

Beats in order: hook flex, the breakdown, proof number, pattern interrupt, the human reason, humility, the kicker. Her original cuts to the interviewer; with solo footage, use the full frame where she'd cut away.

Camera: tight on the face for the flex, full frame for the breakdown, tight for the confession, full frame for the kicker.
